title: Govt Disinvests 2.52% Base Stake in Cochin Shipyard via OFS at ₹1,400 Floor Price
summary: Unlocks PSU equity via Offer for Sale (OFS) with an additional 2.52% green-shoe oversubscription option.

blocks.content: Unlocks PSU equity via Offer for Sale (OFS) with an additional 2.52% green-shoe oversubscription option.

items: Divestment Structure: Base 2.52% stake plus 2.52% green-shoe option at ₹1,400 per share floor price.
Government Stake: Union Government holds 67.91% equity stake in Cochin Shipyard Ltd (CSL).
Disinvestment Target: FY27 budget target set at ₹80,000 crore for PSU disinvestment and asset monetisation.
